title: 地下車站活塞風控制
summary: 本課聚焦列車活塞效應旁通開口與壓力瞬變。從列車誘導壓力量級建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把風機與活塞作用疊合與壓力量測誤差合成連成可驗證的介面，最後以不同列車通過情境整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies train piston effects bypass openings and pressure transients. Start with scale of train-induced pressure to define physical or information boundaries, connect fans interacting with piston effects with combining pressure measurement uncertainty as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through scenarios for different train passages. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 列車誘導壓力量級與活塞風斷面積分
stages.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure & Section integration of piston airflow
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車誘導壓力量級」與「活塞風斷面積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scale of train-induced pressure" and "Section integration of piston airflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車誘導壓力量級」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scale of train-induced pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。動壓與風速平方成正比，這有助判斷列車活塞作用與門扇負載的量級。實際瞬變壓力仍受隧道阻塞率、旁通開口與波傳反射影響；動壓不是任何測點必定出現的靜壓差，兩者不能直接等同。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車誘導壓力量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. Dynamic pressure scales with speed squared, helping estimate the magnitude of train-induced airflow and door loading. Actual transients also depend on blockage, bypass openings and wave reflections. Dynamic pressure is not automatically the static pressure difference measured at a particular location. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scale of train-induced pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車誘導壓力量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scale of train-induced pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. Dynamic pressure scales with speed squared, helping estimate the magnitude of train-induced airflow and door loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列車誘導壓力量級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scale of train-induced pressure" is correct?
options: 風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍
本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。
一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求
optionsEn: Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure.
Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection.
One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車誘導壓力量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scale of train-induced pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=0.5*rho*v*v gives y=135 Pa. Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列車誘導壓力量級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scale of train-induced pressure", which statement holds?
options: 風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成

原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。
optionsEn: A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列車誘導壓力量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale of train-induced pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。以「列車誘導壓力量級」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign. For scale of train-induced pressure, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把代表風速 v 從 15 改成 16.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 135 變為 163.35 Pa。先說明「列車誘導壓力量級」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only representative air speed v from 15 to 16.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 135 to 163.35 Pa. Explain the causal direction for scale of train-induced pressure, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。以「列車誘導壓力量級」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign. For scale of train-induced pressure, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「列車誘導壓力量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scale of train-induced pressure"?
options: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。

optionsEn: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「列車誘導壓力量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale of train-induced pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。回到「列車誘導壓力量級」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. Trace the input chain for scale of train-induced pressure. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。回到「列車誘導壓力量級」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. Trace the input chain for scale of train-induced pressure. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。
一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求

A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks.
One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements.

quiz.explanationEn: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 活塞風斷面積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Section integration of piston airflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「活塞風斷面積分」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section integration of piston airflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元在列車進出站期間量測有正負號的速度，防止正反流動被平均後誤判為持續單向送風。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。風向與煙氣來源位置同樣重要；正常通風的舒適性目標和火災時的煙流控制目標不能共用一個數字就視為完成驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「活塞風斷面積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure signed velocity during train entry and departure, preventing reversing flow from being mistaken for sustained one-way ventilation. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean. Direction and smoke-source location also matter. Normal comfort ventilation and emergency smoke control cannot be validated by one shared number alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section integration of piston airflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「活塞風斷面積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Section integration of piston airflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Measure signed velocity during train entry and departure, preventing reversing flow from being mistaken for sustained one-way ventilation. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean.

knowledge.text: 誤解：一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure signed velocity during train entry and departure, preventing reversing flow from being mistaken for sustained one-way ventilation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 活塞風斷面積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Section integration of piston airflow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「活塞風斷面積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section integration of piston airflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「活塞風斷面積分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

把相鄰壓力資料內插成更多點就能恢復任何短暫峰值

optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 活塞風斷面積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Section integration of piston airflow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「活塞風斷面積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section integration of piston airflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。以「活塞風斷面積分」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions. For section integration of piston airflow, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把有效通風面積 A 從 16 改成 17.6 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 m/s。先說明「活塞風斷面積分」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only effective airflow area A from 16 to 17.6 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for section integration of piston airflow, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 活塞風斷面積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Section integration of piston airflow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「活塞風斷面積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section integration of piston airflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。回到「活塞風斷面積分」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. Trace the input chain for section integration of piston airflow. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。回到「活塞風斷面積分」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. Trace the input chain for section integration of piston airflow. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「活塞風斷面積分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Section integration of piston airflow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Quadrupling pressure difference necessarily quadruples opening flow.
One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average.
quiz.explanation: 單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。 需以量測區分可能原因。
